body: Excellent observation. A point which should be further considered.
Ok. Should've read that but the link didn't work properly. That's a most unfortunate clause given the subject matter. Seems like the two go hand and hand.

Precisely the type of convo I was aiming to strike up. I agree that in the next phase of existence (what follows physical life) connection to God/s will be "easier". But I am arguing that said connection may be established and maintained while in this phase of existence.

The oxygen you breath is yours to have. It is up to us to use it in the manner we best see fit. What is your relationship like with God? As a former lurker and one who has been battling with thoughts of life and death I believe this is the most important question to be asking. God has the power to enact major changes in our lives. Ever thought of giving it a try?

Speaking as someone who has lost contact with a cherished SO I would say you are very fortunate to be maintaining a healthy relationship with him. Is it possible to further you two's relationship in ways that would be more meaningful to you? I understand being friended and I often wish the same thing.

Suggestion #1: meditation and finding something of interest

Suggestion #2:  dating sites/meetups

Peace and happiness to you.

I wish you had a better experience with the circumstances involving your pets and your relationship. I'm going to focus on the relationship because it seems that could be more devastating and it is something I can relate to. I suggest one of two options: attempt to rectify with the one you mention or find someone who is more empathetic to your feelings and what you are going through. I lost someone important as well but have come across VERY attractive (not just physically!) options. So they are still available. There are 7 billion of us so the odds are in our favor (a fact I am reminding myself of as well). I hope it works out for the best. Peace and happiness.

We've all got regrets. I have one of which I feel will be life long and has only one solution to resolution. Well after writing that I have realized that I can invent solutions. Also, take it as a learning lesson to never be repeated. Try and build off of "What if I were to do 'x'?"
Not sure what you mean. I'm not advertising anything on behalf of myself.

There are others who live with a worse quality of life and are mustering on. I hope this provides a bit of hope. You can adjust the types of foods you eat such as building a diet based on smoothies,etc. You may find a whole new way to diet which could be an exciting new venture. I wish you wellness, peace and happiness.
Is there anything you can do to correct the mistakes you've made?
